```{python}
#| output: false
import os
import re

import pandas as pd
import yaml

cfg = yaml.safe_load(open("configs/settings.yaml"))

components_dir = cfg["remi_components_dir"]
data_dir = cfg["data_dir"]
county_map = cfg["county_map"]  # "King County" -> id
bare_county_map = {name.replace(" County", ""): name for name in county_map}  # "King" -> "King County"

COMPONENT_LABELS = {
    "Total Migrants - All Races": "Migration",
    "Natural Growth - All Races": "Natural Increase",
}

# OFM sheet name -> component label; column headers span an April-to-April
# period (e.g. "1960-1961") and some Jurisdiction values carry footnote marks,
# so counties are matched on the plain "County" column instead.
OFM_SHEETS = {
    "Residual Net Migration": "Migration",
    "Natural Change": "Natural Increase",
}


def load_remi_components(file_path):
    """Read a REMI components workbook's Migration and Natural Increase rows
    by county (in thousands) into a long [region, component, year, value] frame."""
    df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name="All", header=5)
    df = df.rename(columns={df.columns[0]: "region", df.columns[1]: "category"})
    year_cols = list(df.columns[3:])

    comp = df[df["region"].isin(county_map) & df["category"].isin(COMPONENT_LABELS)].copy()
    comp["component"] = comp["category"].map(COMPONENT_LABELS)

    long = comp.melt(
        id_vars=["region", "component"],
        value_vars=year_cols,
        var_name="year",
        value_name="value",
    )
    long["year"] = long["year"].astype(int)
    long["value"] = long["value"].astype(float) * 1000
    return long


def load_ofm_components(file_path):
    """Read the OFM components-of-change workbook's Natural Change and Residual
    Net Migration sheets by county into a long [region, component, year, value]
    frame, attributing each April-to-April period to its ending year to match
    the population estimate it feeds into."""
    frames = []
    for sheet_name, component in OFM_SHEETS.items():
        df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name=sheet_name, skiprows=3)
        df["region"] = df["County"].map(bare_county_map)
        df = df.loc[df["region"].notna()].copy()

        year_cols = [c for c in df.columns if re.search(r"\d{4}-\d{4}", str(c))]
        long = df.melt(id_vars="region", value_vars=year_cols, var_name="period", value_name="value")
        long["year"] = long["period"].str.extract(r"\d{4}-(\d{4})").astype(int)
        long["component"] = component
        frames.append(long[["region", "component", "year", "value"]])
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)


comp_frames = []
for comp_file in cfg["remi_components_files"]:
    file_path = os.path.join(components_dir, comp_file["filename"])
    df = load_remi_components(file_path)
    df["name"] = comp_file["name"]
    comp_frames.append(df)
components = pd.concat(comp_frames, ignore_index=True)

ofm_components = load_ofm_components(os.path.join(data_dir, cfg["ofm_components_file"]))

# "Region" is the sum of the four counties, computed here rather than relying on a workbook total row.
region_totals = components.groupby(["name", "component", "year"], as_index=False)["value"].sum()
region_totals["region"] = "Region"
components = pd.concat([components, region_totals], ignore_index=True)

ofm_region_totals = ofm_components.groupby(["component", "year"], as_index=False)["value"].sum()
ofm_region_totals["region"] = "Region"
ofm_components = pd.concat([ofm_components, ofm_region_totals], ignore_index=True)

scenario_names = [comp_file["name"] for comp_file in cfg["remi_components_files"]]

# OFM is the historical source of truth for every year it covers (from 1990 on);
# REMI scenario years that overlap with OFM history are dropped in favor of the OFM values.
history_min_year = 1990
comp_hist = ofm_components.loc[ofm_components["year"] >= history_min_year].assign(name="History")
history_max_year = int(comp_hist["year"].max())
comp_forecast = components.loc[components["year"] > history_max_year]
comp_all = pd.concat([comp_hist, comp_forecast], ignore_index=True)

# Average annual values by period for the combined region, split at history_max_year like the plot above.
# The 2020s decade is split into a History-only period and a forecast-only period so neither column
# blends partial-decade data across the history/forecast boundary.
periods = [
    ("1990s", 1990, 1999),
    ("2000s", 2001, 2009),
    ("2010s", 2010, 2019),
    (f"2020-{history_max_year}", 2020, history_max_year),
    (f"{history_max_year + 1}-2039", history_max_year + 1, 2039),
    ("2040-2060", 2040, 2060),
]


def period_avg_table(component):
    subset = comp_all.loc[(comp_all["region"] == "Region") & (comp_all["component"] == component)]
    avgs = [
        subset.loc[(subset["year"] >= start) & (subset["year"] <= end)]
        .groupby("name")["value"]
        .mean()
        .rename(label)
        for label, start, end in periods
    ]
    return pd.concat(avgs, axis=1).T[["History"] + scenario_names]


migration_avg_table = period_avg_table("Migration")
natural_increase_avg_table = period_avg_table("Natural Increase")

# Chart shows a trailing 3-year rolling average per series; period tables above use the unsmoothed annual values.
comp_chart = comp_all.sort_values(["region", "component", "name", "year"]).copy()
comp_chart["value"] = comp_chart.groupby(["region", "component", "name"])["value"].transform(
    lambda s: s.rolling(3, min_periods=1).mean()
)

ojs_define(data=comp_chart, base_year=history_max_year)
```

```{ojs}
viewof yearFrom = Inputs.range([minYear, maxYear], {label: "Start Year", step: 5, value: minYear})
```

```{ojs}
viewof yearTo = Inputs.range([minYear, maxYear], {label: "End Year", step: 5, value: maxYear})
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedScenario = Inputs.radio(scenarioNames, {label: "Scenario", value: scenarioNames.includes("REMI Medium") ? "REMI Medium" : scenarioNames[0]})
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedRegion = Inputs.select(regionNames, {label: "Region", value: "Region"})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
allData = transpose(data)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
minYear = Math.floor(d3.min(allData, d => d.year) / 5) * 5
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
maxYear = Math.ceil(d3.max(allData, d => d.year) / 5) * 5
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// History always shown; the scenario selector toggles which single forecast bar is shown.
scenarioNames = Array.from(new Set(allData.map(d => d.name))).filter(n => n !== "History").sort()
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// "Region" (sum of counties) plus each individual county, computed in Python.
regionNames = ["Region", ...Array.from(new Set(allData.map(d => d.region))).filter(n => n !== "Region").sort()]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
filtered = allData.filter(d =>
  d.region === selectedRegion &&
  (d.name === "History" || d.name === selectedScenario) &&
  d.year >= yearFrom &&
  d.year <= yearTo
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// x is a band scale (one entry per year), so a numeric `ticks` count doesn't thin labels; build an explicit array instead.
xTickStep = (yearTo - yearFrom) > 40 ? 10 : (yearTo - yearFrom) > 15 ? 5 : 1
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
xTicks = d3.range(Math.ceil(yearFrom / xTickStep) * xTickStep, yearTo + 1, xTickStep)
```

# Notes

- **History**: OFM postcensal estimates of natural change and net migration, identical across all scenarios through `{python} history_max_year`.
- **Migration**: net migrants (in-migration minus out-migration).
- **Natural Increase**: births minus deaths.
- **Region**: sum of King, Kitsap, Pierce, and Snohomish counties; individual counties can also be selected from the sidebar.
- Scenario forecasts:
  - **REMI Medium**: Default REMI forecast released August 2026
  - **REMI Low**: Uses the "Census Low" international migration scenario
  - **REMI High**: Uses the "Census High" international migration scenario
  - **Zero_Intl_Mig**: Assumes zero international migration
